characteristics.name: Properties
characteristics.$text: Mounted warriors move up to 9" during a Move action. Enemies armed with Spear or Naginata gain +1die on Strike and Avoid actions against mounted warriors.

sharedRules.name: Move Up
sharedRules.description: The warrior makes a free move action.

sharedRules.name: Follow Up
sharedRules.description: The warrior makes a free Charge action. If no enemies are in range, the warrior can Move Up instead.

sharedRules.name: Quick Jab
sharedRules.description: Roll 1 die - if any swords are rolled, enemy warrior takes a single blood drop.

sharedRules.name: Fast Shot
sharedRules.description: The target warrior loses 1 die from his avoid roll.

sharedRules.name: Backhand Strike
sharedRules.description: The attacker is knocked to the ground.

sharedRules.name: Fearsome Blow
sharedRules.description: If the attack results in a light wound, all enemy warriors within 6" must test for loss of nerve (including target warrior).

sharedRules.name: Stun
sharedRules.description: If the target warrior fails his avoid roll then he is knocked to the ground.

sharedRules.name: Counter Strike
sharedRules.description: The attacker is forced back as normal. The target warrior immediately makes a free charge action.

sharedRules.name: Twin Strike
sharedRules.description: Target warrior looses 1 die on avoid roll.

sharedRules.name: Deep Cut
sharedRules.description: If the attack results in a light wound, roll one die. Every sword rolled causes an additional blood drop

sharedRules.name: Impale
sharedRules.description: If the target warrior fails his avoid roll then attacker gets +1 die on his Damage Roll.

sharedRules.name: Geisha Spy
sharedRules.description: The Geisha Spy cannot be attacked with a Charge or Shoot action until she has made a Charge action. Enemies gain +1 dice on Damage rolls against the Geisha Spy.

sharedRules.name: Order the Charge
sharedRules.description: After the Sergeant makes a Move action, in addition he an order a friendly commoner within 6" to charge as a free action. There must be a suitable target within range.

sharedRules.name: Rally the Troops
sharedRules.description: If the Musician is within 12" when a friendly commoner checks for loss of nerve, receive +1 die to the roll.

sharedRules.name: Defend the Flag
sharedRules.description: If the Banner Bearer is within 6" when a friendly commoner attempts to avoid an attack, add +1 die to the roll.

sharedRules.name: Concentrate Fire
sharedRules.description: If the Sergeant of Archery is within 3" when a group of bowmen shoots, the group gains +1 die to the Strike roll.

sharedRules.name: Group 3 left
sharedRules.description: Honour +1 when 3 left in the group

sharedRules.name: Group 2 or 3 left
sharedRules.description: Aim +1 when 2 or 3 left in the group
